gdpr.export: Your trust level, your daily reading and visit counts, and your trust level history.
gdpr.delete: Deletes your daily reading and visit counts and your trust level history.

limits.links: {level} members can add {max} links to a post. Remove {over} to post it.
limits.images: {level} members can add {max} images to a post. Remove {over} to post it.
limits.mentions: {level} members can mention {max} people in a post. Remove {over} to post it.
limits.post_seconds: {level} members can post once every {max} seconds. Try again in {over} seconds.
limits.discussions_day: {level} members can start {max} discussions a day. Try again tomorrow.
limits.messages_day: {max, plural, =0 {{level} members can't send private messages.} other {{level} members can send # private messages a day.}}
limits.lifted: You can do more once you reach {level}.

api.silenced: Your account is on hold while a moderator looks at a reported post. You can't send messages until then.
api.group_reserved: A level can't use the Admin, Guest, Member or Mod group. Pick or create a group of its own.
api.group_twice: Each level needs its own group.
api.group_ladder: That group is one of Ladder's ranks. Ladder moves members in and out of it, so a level can't use it too.

You've reached **{level}**. Thanks for taking part.

notifications.reached_excerpt: See what it unlocks and what comes next.

notifications.dropped_flags: Some of your posts were reported and a moderator agreed.
notifications.dropped_other: A moderator changed your trust level.

silenced.title: Your account is on hold.
silenced.body: Members reported one of your posts, so it's hidden while a moderator takes a look. Until then you can read, but not post, reply, edit, send messages, like or react.

messages.from_level: You can send private messages once you reach {level}.
messages.on_hold: You can't send private messages while your account is on hold.

page.title: Trust level
page.unavailable: This member's trust level isn't available.
page.silenced_own: Your account is on hold while a moderator looks at a reported post. You can still read everything.
page.silenced_staff: On hold: members reported a post, and it's hidden. Lift the hold, or confirm it's spam.
page.keep_sub: Checked every day, counted over the last 100 days. Falling a little short is fine.
page.leader_by_staff: {level} is given by the staff to members they trust most.
page.confirm_spam_prompt: Hide all of {username}'s posts and suspend them? Use this for spam accounts only.

permissions.manage: See and set members' trust levels, lift holds

admin.buzz_name: A member reaches a new trust level

dashboard.stale: The hourly check hasn't run for over two hours. Make sure Flarum's scheduler runs (php flarum schedule:run every minute), or use Run now. New and Basic members are still checked as they read and post.
dashboard.close_empty: Nobody yet. Members show up here after the first check.
dashboard.busy: A check is already running. Its results will show here when it finishes.

levels.intro: Members reach levels 1 to 3 on their own, each needing the one before. Leave a box empty for the default (shown in grey); 0 turns a requirement off. Requirements whose extension is off aren't counted.
levels.name: Name
levels.group_help: optional: its permissions go to this level and every level above
levels.create_groups_help: Makes a hidden group for each level that has none. Members aren't put in it: their level decides, so no badge ever shows.
levels.grace: Days before a new Regular can drop
levels.grace_help: {level} is the only level that drops when a member goes quiet.

limits.intro: Limits only ever take something away. Leave a box empty for no limit. Staff, the groups ticked below and anyone with the bypass permission are never limited.
limits.approval_help: How many of a {level} member's first posts wait for a moderator (Approval). 0 turns it off.
limits.exempt_help: Members of these groups skip every limit.

spam.needs_flags: Spam defense needs the Flags extension.
spam.docket: Docket is on: its crowd moderation hides reported posts, and each reporter counts by their level (New 0.5 up to Leader 1.5). Trust Levels puts the author on hold when Docket hides their post.
spam.flags_help: Different members reporting the same post hide it at once, until a moderator decides. 0 turns this off.
spam.flagger_level_help: Only reports from members at this level or above count towards hiding. Member by default: Basic takes minutes to reach, so a few new accounts can't team up.
spam.silence_up_to: Put authors on hold up to level
spam.silence_up_to_help: When a post is hidden this way, its author is put on hold if they're at this level or lower: they can read, but not post, reply, edit, message, like or react until a moderator decides.
spam.gatehouse_days_help: A member put on hold this soon after joining goes back to Gatehouse's queue and is signed out. 0 turns it off.
spam.drop_flags: Upheld reports that drop a level
spam.drop_flags_help: When a moderator removes this many of a member's reported posts within 6 months, they drop one level. 0 turns it off.

integrations.ladder_help: Ladder keeps the ranks members see. Trust Levels decides what they may do and stays out of sight. A level can't use one of Ladder's rank groups.
integrations.docket_help: Docket's crowd moderation hides reported posts, with each reporter counted by their trust level.
integrations.gatehouse_help: A member put on hold in their first days goes back to Gatehouse's approval queue.
integrations.sleuth_help: A member Sleuth links to a banned account stays New until staff review the match.
integrations.onramp_help: Adds a step: reach a trust level (the step's count is the level).
integrations.buzz_help: Can show “Ana is now a Regular” in the live activity feed. Levels are otherwise only seen by the member and staff, so it's off until you turn it on.
